SlipstreamRank 1
8% of base mana
Instant cast15 sec cooldown
You liquify your physical form into a pool of healing water for 5 sec, making you unable to act but healing nearby allies for 4+(PL*0.35-1*0.35) every 1 sec.

Each tick consumes 1 stack of Bathe on affected allies to do additional healing for each stack.

This effect also increases your movement speed by 40% and reduces your damage taken by 20%.
